messages:
deploybot: ALERT: prod-canary showing p95 tail spike at 2026-08-18T18:19:59Z. Auto-rollback blocked by release pin. Candidate hotfix: redwood/inference:2026-08-18-hf-kvfix2. Requesting expedited lift of pin and a 20m change window. @kai (release lead) @ops-oncall please ack.

kai: on call. paste the failing snippet?

deploybot: probe: /generate p95=980ms (baseline 160ms). log: `WARN runtime.kv-cache: eviction cascade -> miss storm`

lexi: root cause looks like the new quant-backed cache policy. hotfix reverts the policy and increases soft-ttl. validated in staging: 5/5 smoke runs.

rachel: infra check? any node pressure other than during deploy spikes?

ops-oncall: nodes healthy, short CPU spike during image pull. no IO saturation. no other rolling tasks.

kai: require PM/compliance note before we remove pin. lexi, can QA attest quick smoke?

lexi: QA quick-check green. no semantic diffs in outputs.

compliance-bot: NOTE: release pinned by contract-flag CF-3. Manual compliance signoff required to lift. @rachel will need to toggle.

rachel: legal looped, preparing a short customer-facing note. i can toggle on signoff if canary metrics look good.

kai: proposed plan: lift pin -> canary 7% for 8m -> manual checkpoint -> ramp to 60% over 7m -> final ramp to 100% if stable. rollback triggers: p95 > baseline*1.3 OR errors >0.5% OR kv_evictions/sec > 2x baseline. freeze other deploys during window.

ops-oncall: add `--circuit-breaker 0.5` to the deploy command and `--freeze-new-deploys`. require manual handoff to oncall at checkpoint.

kai: deploybot, queue with those flags and an audit tag.

deploybot: queued: `/deploy --image redwood/inference:2026-08-18-hf-kvfix2 --scope canary --ramp 7% --observe 480s --auto-rollback "p95>+30% || errors>0.5% || kv_evictions>2x" --override-pin release-lead-kai --freeze-new-deploys --circuit-breaker 0.5 --manual-checkpoint --audit "hf-kvfix2-unpin-0818"`

kai: +approve (release lead, expedite). lexi?

lexi: +eng. QA signed.

ops-oncall: +ack, freezing new deploys. waiting for compliance toggle.

rachel: compliance ok to toggle once initial canary has three consecutive stable checks. publishing draft customer note now.

deploybot: APPROVALS: release-lead kai and eng lexi. Waiting for compliance toggle to lift pin.

rachel: compliance toggled `--compliance-ok` at 18:24 UTC.

deploybot: 18:25 UTC - canary 7% started. posting telemetry every 2m.

ops-oncall: watching traces. initial p95=210ms (baseline 160ms) -> 230ms at 2m. errors 0.02%. kv_evictions/sec trending down.

deploybot: 18:33 UTC - telemetry: p50/p95/p99 = 38ms/220ms/560ms (baseline 35/160/500). errors 0.03%. within thresholds.

kai: manual checkpoint: ops, do you want ramp to 60%?

ops-oncall: +handoff-approve, metrics look stable. proceed to ramp to 60% with circuit-breaker active.

deploybot: ramping to 60% over 7m.

deploybot: 18:40 UTC - ramp to 60% complete. telemetry p95=175ms, errors 0.02%.

rachel: sending customer notification and updating changelog link: https://go/release/2026-08-18-hf-kvfix2

lexi: continue monitoring 10m, if stable proceed to 100%.

ops-oncall: monitoring; will trigger immediate rollback on threshold breach.

deploybot: 18:51 UTC - final ramp to 100% complete. pin removed, audit saved: hf-kvfix2-unpin-0818, run-id 20260818-d7f.

kai: thanks all. follow-up: postmortem to document the quant->kv interaction and add rollout gating. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
